title: Make signUp persistence null-check cleanup symmetric
objective: Ensure signUp returns Failure and clears partial session state when either UUID persistence or token persistence fails.
acceptance_criteria: AuthRepository.signUp applies the same Failure return path when saveUuid fails and when saveToken fails
Both persistence failure branches clear in-memory auth fields and any persisted counterpart data
No branch leaves a saved token without UUID or a saved UUID without token
Existing successful signUp behavior and return type are preserved
flutter analyze for auth repository files reports no new errors
